title: Flatness of the two factors in the pointed etale completion map
statement: For the pointed etale colimit cocone, each stage-to-colimit map and the colimit-to-adic-completion map at the extended maximal ideal is flat.

source.place: Tag 06LJ, proof of (c), paragraph beginning To finish the proof of (c)

proof.text: The given cocone witnesses IsStrictHenselization R K c.pt. Apply IsStrictHenselization.triples_presentation to get a residue-triple ring colimit with the same vertex and base map; apply strictHenselization_faithfullyFlat to this colimit to get Module.Flat R c.pt. Give c.pt its stage action via the coprojection. The stage is etale and hence formally unramified of finite type; Mathlib Algebra.FormallyUnramified.flat_of_restrictScalars proves that this coprojection is flat.

Use pointedEtale_small_filtered to replace the indexing category by its small filtered model. Whisker the given cocone by the inverse equivalence, preserving IsColimit. Forget from CommAlgCat R to CommRingCat; the equivalence with Under R and preservation of connected colimits by Under.forget show that the resulting ring cocone remains a colimit.

For the completion map gamma, every composite with a ring coprojection is flat by pointedEtale_completion_stage_flat. Use the unique ring isomorphism E from the cocone vertex to the chosen colimit to turn these into the hypotheses of RingHom.flat_of_flat_comp_colimit_ι. This gives flatness of gamma composed with E inverse. Compose with the flat bijection E and simplify the inverse identities to obtain flatness of gamma. Together with the first step, this proves the conjunction.

proof_origin.place: Tag 06LJ, proof of (c); T4 combines existing strict-henselization faithful flatness, Mathlib unramified restriction of flatness, and the filtered-colimit flatness argument

lean.statement:
theorem pointedEtale_completion_stage_flat_factors
    (R K : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [Field K]
    [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K] [Algebra R K]
    [IsScalarTower R (IsLocalRing.ResidueField R) K]
    (c : Cocone ((ObjectProperty.ι
      (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of R K) ↦ Etale R X.left)) ⋙
        Over.forget (CommAlgCat.of R K)))
    (hc : IsColimit c)
    (t : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory
      (fun X : Over (CommAlgCat.of R K) ↦ Etale R X.left)) :
    (c.ι.app t).hom.toRingHom.Flat ∧
      (algebraMap c.pt
        (AdicCompletion ((IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R).map (algebraMap R c.pt)) c.pt)).Flat
